about_the_game:
Everything is held together by thin strings of coordination and vigilance… until someone starts pulling their own.

Pulled Strings is a multiplayer social deduction survival game where success hinges not just on voting — but on trust, coordination, and timely action. Both Innocents and the Maniac share the same goal: hold back the darkness and survive.

Each match in Pulled Strings is a unique experience: whether you're with close friends or complete strangers, you’ll constantly cooperate, trade findings, negotiate roles and build your chain of survival.

⭐ Social deduction meets tense co-op survival with rituals

If the team doesn't work together — everyone is doomed.

⭐ A distinct take on the genre:

A haunting Victorian manor, marionette aesthetics, and gloomy 2D side-scrolling in the tone of dark tales — a fresh spin on your usual “mafia night with friends.”

⭐ A new traitor dynamic:

The Maniac must survive alongside Innocents — so sabotaging resources or killing recklessly may lead to their own doom.

⭐ Power lies in every role:

Every Innocent is a vital link in the survival chain. Your choices influence the entire match — your timing, tasks, and judgment can keep the group alive… or doom it.

⭐ Create your own rhythm of survival: 

Tweak dozens of settings and save custom presets for your group’s favorite balance of chaos and challenge.

Pulled Strings is in Early Access

A live experiment in trust, fear, and survival. We're actively balancing the game, adding new scenarios, creatures, and ritual mechanics — with community feedback at the core of development. Wishlist now and help shape Pulled Strings with your feedback.

Key Gameplay Features EA

  • Cooperation is survival
    Unmasking the traitor is just one piece. You’ll need to manage warmth, light, and complete rituals before the darkness takes over. Without coordination — you won’t make it.

  • Three entities – three playstyles
    The Maniac hides among you, the Shifter turns hunters into prey, and Marionettes must stay tightly woven — or perish.

  • Attention to survival details
    Watch hunger, fatigue, light, and cold — these puppets act a little too human.

  • Rituals to hold back the dark
    Find scattered items and perform rites to delay the encroaching threat. And beware: not all threats are human.

  • Social deception with a twist
    Proximity voice chat, fast in-game text chat and minimal UI keep things tense and immersive.

  • A manor full of secrets
    Explore. Observe. Why is that scratching sound behind the wall… a mouse?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G4560 / AMD A8-7600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GT 610 (512 MB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / NVIDIA GT 770
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB GB available space

short_description: Pulled Strings is a tense social deduction game with co-op survival for 3–10 players. Keep the fire alive, share your supplies, and complete rituals before darkness takes the manor. Something waits in the depths — and some have long since cut their strings.
